corrections.text: This article states that Zhongqi Wuliang "previously built Hanyuan-1... followed by Hanyuan-2." The cited Quantum Computing Report source actually attributes Hanyuan-1 to a different company, stating it was "Developed by Zhongke Kuyuan," and does not attribute Hanyuan-2 to Zhongqi Wuliang either. The source credits Zhongqi Wuliang only with Qinghe No. 1, described in the source's own roadmap list as "Zhongqi Wuliang's single-rack form factor."
